class.name: Box2DDirectSpaceState2D
class.brief_description: Native Box2D shape sweeps with hit positions and travel destinations.
class.description: This backend is provided when the Box2D module is enabled. Obtain the active server or world direct state; do not instantiate this abstract class directly.

method.name: cast_shape
method.description: Sweeps the shape described by [param parameters] along its motion and returns the nearest hit as a [Dictionary], or an empty dictionary if there is no hit. Keys are [code]point[/code] ([Vector2]), [code]destination[/code] (the query origin at the hit fraction), [code]normal[/code] ([Vector2]), [code]shape[/code] (collider shape index), [code]rid[/code] ([RID]), [code]collider_id[/code], and [code]collider[/code] when a scene object exists. Honors the query collision mask, body/area flags, exclusions, and margin. Use a valid non-null query with a valid shape RID; access the world's direct state during the physics frame.

method.name: cast_shape_all
method.description: Sweeps the query shape along its motion and returns up to [param max_results] hit dictionaries ordered by travel fraction. Dictionary fields match [method cast_shape]. A nonpositive result limit or no hits returns an empty typed array. Supply a valid non-null [param parameters] with a valid shape RID and query during the physics frame.
